subject: Request: Consolidated encryption/KMS evidence for SOC2 intake - Aurora Finance
messages:
From: Alice Seymour <alice.seymour@aurorafinance.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurora Security Team <security@aurorafinance.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 13:08:00 +0000
Subject: Request: Consolidated encryption/KMS evidence for SOC2 intake - Aurora Finance

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Aurora's SOC2 intake team is assembling a single bundle for our external auditor and has asked Redwood for a consolidated package covering key management and encryption controls. Can you provide the following by EOD next Tuesday (2026-11-16)?

- A signed HSM attestation (vendor attestation / certificate) covering the cluster used for Aurora tenant keys.
- A trimmed export (CSV) with KMS key rotation events for the past 12 months (include key id, rotation timestamp, operator id, rotation type). We can accept redacted operator identifiers if needed.
- A short document (1 page) describing how keys are wrapped for transit and the TLS cipher policy in effect for inter-service traffic.
- The current key operator access matrix (who can initiate rotations / who approves / emergency contact).

We're aiming to close the SOC2 evidence gate this month. If any of this requires a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) or an additional attestation, let us know immediately.

Attachments: none on our side.

Best,
Alice Seymour
Head of Security Assurance
Aurora Finance
security@aurorafinance.com

From: markus.klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Alice Seymour <alice.seymour@aurorafinance.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aurora Security Team <security@aurorafinance.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:25:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: Consolidated encryption/KMS evidence for SOC2 intake - Aurora Finance

Alice — thanks for the clear list. We're prepared to deliver a compact evidence bundle that meets the auditor's asks and minimizes PII exposure. Planned deliverables and owners: 

- HSM attestation PDF (signed): Ben will coordinate with our HSM vendor for a stamped attestation and any chain-of-trust docs. (owner: ben_carter)
- KMS rotation excerpt CSV: Marissa will export a rotation log and redact operator emails to UUIDs per your allowance. We will include guidance on how to map them to internal roles if you need it. (owner: marissa_cole)
- Transit & wrapping summary (1p): Laura will draft the one-pager describing key wrapping at transit boundaries and our inter-service TLS policy including accepted cipher suites and TLS versions. (owner: laura_bennett)
- Operator access matrix: I'll attach a redacted matrix (operator_matrix_redacted.csv) and include an audit trail summary for emergency procedures.

We plan to upload the bundle to the shared Drive folder and post the DocuSign attestation link for signature by EOD Mon 2026-11-15. To make sure we're scoped correctly: would the auditor accept redacted operator IDs (UUIDs) plus a separate statement confirming that full operator identities can be produced under a mutual NDA or via an on-site review?

I'm attaching an evidence_manifest_template.csv that we'll populate — it lists filenames, checksums, and brief descriptions.

Next steps: Ben will request the attestation, Marissa will prepare a CSV extract with redaction notes, and Laura + I will assemble the narrative. If Aurora needs chain-of-custody logs for key material (e.g., split-key ceremony notes) please flag that now.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
Attachments: evidence_manifest_template.csv

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: markus.klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Alice Seymour <alice.seymour@aurorafinance.com>, Aurora Security Team <security@aurorafinance.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: Consolidated encryption/KMS evidence for SOC2 intake - Aurora Finance

Markus / team — quick status update from the HSM side: vendor has generated a signed attestation PDF covering the enclave IDs used for tenant key wrapping (will request timestamped signature). I expect the signed PDF back by COB today (2026-11-13).

Planned filenames (provisionally):
- HSM_Attestation_Aurora_2026-08-01.pdf (signed attestation)
- kms_rotation_excerpt_2026-11-01.csv (redacted operator UUIDs; rotation type column included)
- operator_matrix_redacted.csv (role -> UUID mapping; no email addresses)
- transit_key_wrap_summary_2026-11-13.pdf (one-page narrative plus cipher list)

Note on redaction: rotation export will replace human-readable operator ids with stable UUIDs and include a separate CSV with role mapping. If the auditor insists on clear identities we can provide them under a formal request.

I'll drop the signed attestation to the Drive link Markus provided and update the evidence manifest with checksums.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
Attachments: none (HSM attestation pending upload)

From: Alice Seymour <alice.seymour@aurorafinance.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurora Security Team <security@aurorafinance.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: Consolidated encryption/KMS evidence for SOC2 intake - Aurora Finance

Markus / Ben / team — this is perfect, thank you. Redacted operator UUIDs are acceptable for now — our auditor prefers that approach for shared vendor evidence. We will submit a formal records access request if they need full identities.

A couple of quick asks before you upload: please ensure the CSV contains UTC timestamps, and include a short README (README_rotation_excerpt.md) with column definitions and redaction notes. Also, please add a checksum column in the manifest for verification.

If you can get the bundle into the Drive and post the DocuSign link by EOD today (11/13), we'll prioritize review and get back with any follow-ups by Friday.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alice
Head of Security Assurance
Aurora Finance
